news.headline: Lilly Left Nektar Drug 'Damaged Goods,' Jury Told At Trial End
news.summary: In closing arguments in the ~$1 billion breach-of-contract trial, Nektar's counsel told a California federal jury that Eli Lilly turned rezpegaldesleukin into 'damaged goods' by breaching the companies' co-development deal and delaying the drug in favor of a competing Lilly asset it later acquired. The jury began deliberating after closing arguments concluded, with no verdict reached yet as of this writing.

news.headline: Lilly Owes Nektar $1B If It Breached Rezpeg Deal, Jury Told
news.summary: Nektar's damages expert testified to the jury that Eli Lilly could owe the company nearly $1 billion if it is found to have breached the 2017 license agreement to co-develop rezpegaldesleukin. The testimony laid out Nektar's financial theory of harm from Lilly's handling of the drug's early atopic dermatitis and lupus trials.

news.headline: Nektar CEO Opens Door To Finance Questions In Eli Lilly Trial
news.summary: Nektar failed to keep evidence of its financial condition out of the trial after CEO testimony on cross-examination prompted the judge to allow it in for impeachment purposes. The ruling gave Lilly's defense additional material to argue Nektar was not harmed by the deal's termination.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA Durability Data
news.summary: Nektar disclosed it is entering a quiet period beginning September 8, 2026 that will continue until it publicly announces data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period of its Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study. The company said the move is consistent with its prior quiet periods ahead of REZOLVE study readouts.

news.headline: Eli Lilly 'Sabotaged' Rezpeg's Development, Nektar Tells Jury
news.summary: In opening statements of the federal trial, Nektar's lawyer told the jury that Eli Lilly breached the companies' co-development deal and 'sabotaged' rezpegaldesleukin's development to favor a competing Lilly drug, while Lilly's counsel countered that Nektar was not harmed by the deal's 2023 termination. The dispute centers on differing analyses of early trial data, with Lilly reporting a 17% placebo-adjusted improvement versus Nektar's 36% reanalysis.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.1 million and a narrowed net loss of $40.6 million, with cash and investments of $1.02 billion as of June 30, 2026, bolstered by a $350 million public offering. The company highlighted the July 2026 start of its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis and finalized design of a registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study.

catalysts.label: Jury verdict in Nektar v. Eli Lilly trial
catalysts.detail: A California federal jury is deliberating on Nektar's ~$1 billion breach-of-contract claim alleging Lilly mishandled and 'sabotaged' rezpegaldesleukin's co-development under their 2017 deal; a verdict could materially affect Nektar's cash position and litigation overhang.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data
catalysts.detail: Nektar has been in a self-imposed quiet period since September 8, 2026 ahead of releasing 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study, a key durability readout for rezpegaldesleukin.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to begin a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, with design finalized following FDA End-of-Phase 2 feedback and EMA scientific advice.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline results are expected from the global registrational ZENITH AD-1/AD-2/AD-3 program (about 1,530 patients) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with a BLA submission targeted for 2029.

pulse: Nektar's story right now is dominated by two binary, near-term events: a California federal jury is deliberating a roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract verdict against Eli Lilly over the botched rezpeg co-development deal after closing arguments on September 18, 2026, and the company has been in a quiet period since September 8 ahead of Q4 2026 REZOLVE-AA durability data in alopecia areata. Q2 2026 results showed a narrowing net loss and cash/investments over $1 billion, funding the newly launched Phase 3 ZENITH AD atopic dermatitis program (initial data not until mid-2028). The stock has rallied strongly off 2026 lows on prior Phase 2b wins, but remains highly sensitive to both the Lilly verdict and the pending alopecia durability readout.
